# age Provider

Generate [age](https://age-encryption.org) X25519 identities and encrypt data to age recipients. Everything happens locally; the provider takes no configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    age = {
      source = "aleksanderaleksic/age"
    }
  }
}

# The provider takes no configuration.
provider "age" {}
```
